CustomField.description: Date by which this article must be re-verified against org metadata. An article past this date is treated as stale and flagged to its owner by the scheduled staleness check (World-Class Agent Standard v2 §1). Populated by the Knowledge load script from the article's repo frontmatter.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: When this date passes, the article is flagged for re-verification. Update the source article in the repo and reload; do not edit the article here.
CustomField.label: Review Date
